fields.Name: IT163 - Diagnostic Bundles Capture, Assembly and Intake
fields.Description: Exercises the Diagnostic Bundles subsystem in-process (deterministic, no model calls). DIAG1: a registered session captures SQL and log entries through the async diagnostic context, and WithoutDiagnosticCapture suppresses capture. DIAG2: chunks assemble into a .mjdiag archive that passes VerifyBundleArchive, and the HMAC download token is single-use. DIAG3: an MJDB v1 encrypted upload goes through intake quarantine and is promoted. DIAG4: intake rejects a non-MJDB upload before any quarantine write. Each check registers and cleans up its own sessions.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Session capture and suppression work; bundles assemble and verify; download tokens are single-use; encrypted intake promotes valid uploads and rejects junk before quarantine.
